name: sirf-hum-functions
description: Sirf Hum Cloud Functions (trusted server logic).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions --project demo-sirf-hum
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --only firestore --project demo-sirf-hum "node --test test/emulator/*.test.mjs"
